summary: std/http: an HTTP/1.1 server reads a slowly sent request head in linear time
details: an HTTP/1.1 server reads a slowly sent request head in linear time; it rescanned and reparsed the whole head on every read. Affected: 0.50.1 and earlier.
changelog: - Security (std/http, native backends): an HTTP/1.1 server reads a slowly sent request head in linear time; it rescanned and reparsed the whole head on every read. Affected: 0.50.1 and earlier.
